query:
SELECT s.id, s.actor_id, s.act_id, s.family
         FROM actor_profile_versions v
         JOIN staged_writes s
           ON s.actor_id = v.actor_id AND s.pre_signed_at = v.created_at
         WHERE v.pending
           AND s.state = 'landed'
           AND s.family = $1
           AND cardinality(s.asserted_parents) > 0
         ORDER BY s.act_id
